fine_trace.note: The xref stream bytes controlled by the PDF set objects 7 and 8 to compressed-object entries, so later resolution will load object stream 9 for those object numbers.

fine_trace.code: orig_x->type = 'O'; /* Mark this node so we know we're recursing. */
fine_trace.note: Resolving compressed object 7 temporarily mutates its xref entry while pdf_load_obj_stm parses the containing object stream.
The attacker-controlled object stream body parses object 7 as another indirect reference, causing an indirect chain to continue through data just loaded from the stream.
The parsed indirect object is stored in the xref cache without keeping a separate resolver-owned reference for the caller that continues chain resolution.
The resolver returns the cached object pointer directly, so subsequent chain iterations operate on an object whose lifetime depends on the xref cache being unchanged.
Chain resolution tests the returned pointer as an indirect object after object-stream loading and cache updates, which is the memory-safety access reached by the reproducer.
